content.text:
Pressing `a` now opens the fall-detected popup. I tested it on your dev server at localhost:3000 and it shows correctly.

- **Title:** "Fall detected" in red, with a warning icon.
- **Subtitle:** "Wife was messaged at 10:08 AM" (whatever the time is when you press it).
- **Description:** says the brace sensor saw a sudden drop followed by no movement, so Alex may have fallen and need help.
- **Closing it:** the Dismiss button, Escape, or clicking outside the popup.
- **Typing:** pressing `a` while typing in a text field won't open it.

The new code is in [FallAlert.tsx](web/components/FallAlert.tsx), and [Dashboard.tsx](web/components/Dashboard.tsx) now includes it so it works in both Family and Physician views. Nothing is committed yet.

I didn't add a test for the hotkey or send a real message to anyone; the "wife was messaged" line is display text only.
Commit the working tree changes with a sensible message.
